findings.highlight: She moves faster than expected.
findings.evidenceJa: まさか、と思うより早かった
findings.governingReading: The girl leaps out before he can even think “surely not.”
findings.explanation: Shirou’s thought is replaced by Saber’s speed.

findings.highlight: His attack almost looks like it caused an explosion.
findings.evidenceJa: 爆薬を叩き付けるような一撃
findings.governingReading: Lancer’s spear glows when it receives Saber’s blow, which is likened to explosives.
findings.explanation: Saber’s explosive blow becomes Lancer’s attack.

findings.highlight: crackles along her opponent's weapon
findings.evidenceJa: 相手の武具に浸透している
findings.governingReading: Saber’s immense magical energy permeates Lancer’s weapon on contact.
findings.explanation: Magical energy penetrating the opposing weapon becomes crackling along it.

findings.highlight: Parrying her strikes must be taking a lot out of the man
findings.evidenceJa: よほど戦いづらいのか
findings.governingReading: Lancer has lost sharpness because the invisible weapon makes the fight difficult.
findings.explanation: Difficulty caused by fighting an unseen weapon becomes fatigue from parrying.

findings.highlight: Her careful, precise attacks earlier may have worn the man down
findings.evidenceJa: 今までのような無駄のない一撃ならいざ知らず
findings.governingReading: Shirou says an efficient earlier blow would be one thing, but this finishing swing cannot catch him.
findings.explanation: A conditional comparison with Saber’s earlier efficient strikes becomes a claim that those strikes wore Lancer down.

findings.highlight: sword is still embedded in the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 地面に剣を打ち付けてしまったまま
findings.governingReading: Saber remains with her sword lowered or struck against the ground.
findings.explanation: A sword brought down against the ground becomes embedded in it.

findings.highlight: The whole thing happens in a matter of seconds.
findings.evidenceJa: その攻防は一秒以内だ
findings.governingReading: The entire attack and counterattack occurs in under one second.
findings.explanation: An exchange completed within one second becomes one lasting several seconds.

findings.highlight: everything leading to this moment was in vain
findings.evidenceJa: そんな物には一片の価値もあるまい
findings.governingReading: Neither values only escaping the crisis because each intended a finishing blow.
findings.explanation: The fighters’ contempt for mere survival after failed killing blows becomes the claim that everything leading there was in vain.

findings.highlight: open a bit of distance
findings.evidenceJa: 間合いは大きく離れた
findings.governingReading: The combatants open a great distance between them.
findings.explanation: A large separation becomes “a bit” of distance.

findings.highlight: She smashes heavily into the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: 地面へと落下—いや、着地した
findings.governingReading: She arcs toward the ground—no, she lands.
findings.explanation: Saber’s apparent fall corrected into a landing becomes a heavy crash.

findings.highlight: her heart is pierced
findings.evidenceJa: その胸を貫かれ
findings.governingReading: At this point her chest is pierced and bleeding; later narration establishes that the heart was missed.
findings.explanation: A pierced chest becomes a pierced heart before the later correction.

findings.highlight: It altered truth itself to make that happen.
findings.evidenceJa: そうなるように過程を変えた
findings.governingReading: The spear does not change course; it changes the process so that the already-given result is established.
findings.explanation: Changing the process read as “fact” becomes altering truth itself.

findings.highlight: the intent of piercing her heart had been realized
findings.evidenceJa: 既に“心臓を貫いている”という“結果”を持ってしまう
findings.governingReading: Once released with its name, the spear already has the result “the heart is pierced.”
findings.explanation: An already possessed result becomes realized intent.

findings.highlight: How the hell did you evade
findings.evidenceJa: 躱したなセイバー
findings.governingReading: He bitterly states that she evaded Gáe Bolg.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s statement that Saber dodged his fatal blow becomes a question asking how.

findings.highlight: They're even telling me to retreat since my spear failed.
findings.evidenceJa: 槍が躱されたのなら帰ってこい
findings.governingReading: Lancer quotes his employer’s prior conditional instruction.
findings.explanation: A standing order to return if the spear is dodged becomes a command being issued during the scene.

findings.highlight: I'll kill you.
findings.evidenceJa: 決死の覚悟を抱いて来い
findings.governingReading: If she follows, she must come with resolve for a fight to the death.
findings.explanation: Lancer’s warning to come prepared to die becomes a promise that he will kill Saber.

findings.highlight: She is absolutely beautiful.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺より何歳か年下のような少女
findings.governingReading: Before describing her beauty, he perceives her as a girl apparently a few years younger than himself.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s estimate that Saber looks several years younger disappears.

findings.highlight: a touch of contempt in her tone, but it remains mostly gentle
findings.evidenceJa: 慇懃なくせに穏やか
findings.governingReading: Her manner is polite/formal yet gentle, which disarms Shirou.
findings.explanation: Saber’s courteous, gentle tone is said to contain contempt.

findings.highlight: important to remain rational no matter who I'm dealing with
findings.evidenceJa: どんな相手にだって筋は通さないとダメ
findings.governingReading: Even while confused, he believes he must deal properly and honorably with anyone.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s need to observe proper conduct becomes a need to remain rational.

findings.highlight: not focused on me, but something elsewhere
findings.evidenceJa: 遠く—塀の向こうに向けられている
findings.governingReading: Her focus is far away, beyond the wall, where she senses the next enemies.
findings.explanation: Saber’s attention beyond the wall is reduced to something vaguely elsewhere.

findings.highlight: I feel like I've said something that disappoints her.
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもない間違いを口にした気がする
findings.governingReading: He senses that his answer contains an enormous mistake after her slight frown.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s feeling that he said something terribly mistaken becomes certainty that he disappointed Saber.
